date_text: Thu, Aug 13th • 12:00 PM AEST - Thu, Aug 13th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Always a favourite at Hotel Sweeney’s, Woolshed Brewery is back on the rooftop, bringing their solid styles and a splash of fun. From the sherbet-orange hit of the Big Orange Sour, to the impeccable hop punch of the Cherax Destructor IPA, right through to the seasonal ‘The Perfect Stick’— absolutely perfect for this kind of weather — there’s a brew for every mood. Fingers crossed for a sunny Thursday and Friday rolling into the weekend, but rain or shine, book a table for an afternoon well spent. Tap List - Aussie Lager - Amazon Ale - Summer Ale - Cherax Destructor - Hazy Pale - Big Orange - Outback Amber Ale - Vodka Raspberry - Great Southern Trend Killer - The Perfect Stick - Judas The Dark - Ginger Beer
